newsitem.title: UK: Firmer sterling weighs on Bradford wool prices.
newsitem.headline: Firmer sterling weighs on Bradford wool prices.

text.p: Traders said currency remains the main reason for any price reductions still being made locally, with sterling again stronger at the end of last week.
Dull trading also contributed to any decisions to lower prices a little further.

New orders are not coming through despite reductions due to currency factors over the Easter recess, and although deliveries are still said to be going out well, even this aspect is not quite so clear during a period affected by recent holidays.
Australian wool sales are resumed this week with offerings relatively large and indicators over the past two weeks failing to indicate bullish sentiment.
Most assessments were that prices would show no dramatic change in remaining weeks of the season but a few traders seem doubtful about strength in the immediate future, citing lack of demand.
